outcome: Newborn weight loss (NWL) in the first 96 hours of life
cohort: 1288 full-term singleton newborns without congenital abnormality, born in 2005-2006 in Porto, Portugal
finding: The study found that excessive newborn weight loss in the first 96 hours of life was positively associated with advanced maternal age, higher maternal education, cesarean delivery, and phototherapy-treated jaundice, while insufficient NWL was associated with low birth weight and formula/mixed feeding.
mod_finding: Excessive NWL was positively associated with cesarean delivery.
